description: Fix \(n,p,x\) and an approximation \(a\). If \(p\) presents \(a\) at \(x\), \(a(0,x)=0\), and \(c_a(s,x)\le n\) for every \(s\), then the actual clipped state \((k_s,b_s,c_s)\) satisfies \(b_s=a(k_s-1,x)\) and \(c_s=c_a(k_s-1,x)\). If \(c_s=n\), every \(a(t,x)\) with \(t\ge k_s-1\) equals \(b_s\). Subtraction is truncated at zero.
